why_vendored: DALEOBANKS CI cannot check out uniimente-kernel: the default GITHUB_TOKEN is scoped to this repository, and a cross-repository checkout returned git exit 128. Fixing that properly requires a personal access token, which is a founder credential decision and is deliberately not created here. Vendoring the exact wheels keeps the property that actually matters - the organ installs a BUILT ARTIFACT, never the Kernel source tree - while needing no credential.
cost: Binary artifacts in git, and they must be refreshed deliberately when the Kernel changes. CI verifies these hashes, so a stale or tampered wheel fails the run rather than passing quietly.
preferred_fix: A read-only PAT for dababiyoda/uniimente-kernel stored as a DALEOBANKS actions secret, restoring the build-from-pinned-ref step. Founder decision.
note_on_hashes: sha256 is the archive hash and is now byte-reproducible because SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is pinned. content_hash is the identity of what the wheel CONTAINS, independent of archive metadata. A same-version different-content_hash artifact must be refused even where byte reproducibility is unavailable.
